style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimalist solid-wood bedroom furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream ivory #F5F2E9, warm light grey #E8E6E1, deep charcoal-brown #241F1A, white cards #FFFFFF, and one copper-orange accent #C87A3C; warm color temperature; modern geometric sans-serif headline typography only; consistent rounded-rectangle info cards and copper pill labels; consistent thin-line copper icons; clean interior photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with copy set directly on the scene or card; natural oak and walnut wood surfaces; rounded arch dividers with a small copper triangle mark between sections; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no label style drift between sections
style.presentationRules: stable eye-level 3/4 hero angle for room contexts, product always grounded with contact shadow, consistent scale across panels, copy set directly on the scene or card
style.surfaceSystem: natural oak and walnut wood grain surfaces, matte painted walls, soft grey-blue bedding textiles, light wood block material piles
